teaching.title: Introductory Programming Tutoring
bullets: Guided beginning programmers through practice exercises involving variables, conditionals, and functions during tutoring sessions.
Discussed debugging approaches during tutoring sessions and asked learners to explain the steps in their solutions.

projects.title: Contact Index
bullets: Contributed linked structures and traversal operations to a team contact index project using Java and Git.

projects.title: Dependency Ordering
bullets: Represented connections using adjacency lists for an individual dependency ordering course project using Java and Git.
Tested connected, disconnected, and cyclic examples, and explained algorithm choices and computational complexity.

projects.title: Recipe Organiser

Tested representative inputs, recorded expected outputs, added input checks, and handled invalid entries.
